Due to the unpredictable nature of the technology, large language models can sometimes generate output that may contain offensive material, such as toxic, profane, or sexist language. Now Assist Guardian monitors for and detects offensive material in generated content.

Due to the unpredictable nature of the technology, large language models can sometimes generate output that may contain offensive material, such as toxic, profane, or sexist language. Now Assist Guardian monitors for and detects offensive material in generated content.

Monitoring is always on, and you can use logs to determine how often offensive content is generated. Blocking the content may increase latency, and, depending on your use case, it is possible false positives may worsen the user experience more than improve risk posture.
